# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
clean_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "`", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(x, "\\s+", "")
  x <- stringr::str_replace(x, "^g(?=[0-9]{1,3}-[0-9]{4,6}$)", "")
  x
}

find_first_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- intersect(candidates, names(df))
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit[1]
}

extract_bracket_id <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_match(as.character(x), "\\[([0-9]+)\\]$")[, 2]
}

extract_validation_name <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_remove(as.character(x), "\\s*\\[[0-9]+\\]$"))
}

save_tiff <- function(plot, filename, width, height) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(figure_dir, filename),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300,
    compression = "lzw"
  )
}

# Reproduce the original preprocessing order exactly:
# 1) log2(x + 1) transform when all observed values are non-negative;
# 2) calculate means and SDs from the observed (non-missing) values;
# 3) replace missing values with the corresponding metabolite mean; and
# 4) z-score using the means and SDs calculated before imputation.
preprocess_full_matrix <- function(X_raw) {
  X_raw <- as.matrix(X_raw)
  storage.mode(X_raw) <- "numeric"

  use_log2 <- all(X_raw >= 0 | is.na(X_raw))
  X_work <- if (use_log2) log2(X_raw + 1) else X_raw

  # Match the original code: estimate both parameters before imputation.
  means <- colMeans(X_work, na.rm = TRUE)
  sds <- apply(X_work, 2, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)

  means[!is.finite(means)] <- 0
  sds[!is.finite(sds) | sds == 0] <- 1

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X_work))) {
    miss <- is.na(X_work[, j])
    if (any(miss)) X_work[miss, j] <- means[j]
  }

  X_scaled <- scale(X_work, center = means, scale = sds)

  list(
    X = X_scaled,
    means = means,
    sds = sds,
    use_log2 = use_log2
  )
}

# Apply the same original preprocessing order within each participant subset.
# The feature set is held fixed, but subset-specific means and SDs are estimated
# from observed values before missing values are mean-imputed.
preprocess_subsample_matrix <- function(X_raw_subset, use_log2) {
  X_work <- as.matrix(X_raw_subset)
  storage.mode(X_work) <- "numeric"

  if (use_log2) X_work <- log2(X_work + 1)

  # Match the full-data preprocessing: calculate SDs before imputation.
  means <- colMeans(X_work, na.rm = TRUE)
  sds <- apply(X_work, 2, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)

  means[!is.finite(means)] <- 0
  sds[!is.finite(sds) | sds == 0] <- 1

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X_work))) {
    miss <- is.na(X_work[, j])
    if (any(miss)) X_work[miss, j] <- means[j]
  }

  scale(X_work, center = means, scale = sds)
}

adjusted_rand_index <- function(reference, candidate) {
  tab <- table(reference, candidate)
  choose2 <- function(x) x * (x - 1) / 2

  n <- sum(tab)
  if (n < 2) return(NA_real_)

  observed <- sum(choose2(tab))
  row_pairs <- sum(choose2(rowSums(tab)))
  col_pairs <- sum(choose2(colSums(tab)))
  total_pairs <- choose2(n)
  expected <- row_pairs * col_pairs / total_pairs
  maximum <- 0.5 * (row_pairs + col_pairs)
  denominator <- maximum - expected

  if (denominator == 0) return(1)
  (observed - expected) / denominator
}

# Resolve arbitrary k-means label switching by maximizing agreement with the
# full-data reference assignments among participants present in the subset.
align_labels_by_overlap <- function(reference, candidate, k) {
  overlap <- table(
    factor(reference, levels = seq_len(k)),
    factor(candidate, levels = seq_len(k))
  )

  # assignment[r] gives the candidate cluster matched to reference cluster r.
  assignment <- as.integer(clue::solve_LSAP(overlap, maximum = TRUE))
  candidate_to_reference <- setNames(seq_len(k), assignment)
  as.integer(candidate_to_reference[as.character(candidate)])
}

cluster_jaccard <- function(reference, candidate, cluster_id) {
  ref_set <- reference == cluster_id
  new_set <- candidate == cluster_id
  union_n <- sum(ref_set | new_set)
  if (union_n == 0) return(NA_real_)
  sum(ref_set & new_set) / union_n
}

permanova_one_factor <- function(distance_object, variable, variable_name,
                                 permutations = 999) {
  keep <- !is.na(variable)
  variable <- droplevels(factor(variable[keep]))

  if (length(unique(variable)) < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      term = variable_name, df = NA_real_, sum_of_squares = NA_real_,
      R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  distance_subset <- as.dist(as.matrix(distance_object)[keep, keep])
  dat <- data.frame(test_variable = variable)
  fit <- vegan::adonis2(
    distance_subset ~ test_variable,
    data = dat,
    permutations = permutations
  )

  tibble(
    term = variable_name,
    df = fit$Df[1],
    sum_of_squares = fit$SumOfSqs[1],
    R2 = fit$R2[1],
    F = fit$F[1],
    p_value = fit$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
}
```

# Prepare the KPMP matrix

```{r prepare-kpmp}
prepare_kpmp <- function(plasma_path, clinical_path) {
  plasma_raw <- readxl::read_excel(plasma_path) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()

  pid_col  <- find_first_col(
    plasma_raw,
    c("participant_id", "participant", "participantid")
  )
  met_col  <- find_first_col(plasma_raw, c("metabolite", "metabolite_id"))
  ab_col   <- find_first_col(
    plasma_raw,
    c("abundance", "value", "intensity", "peak_area")
  )
  name_col <- find_first_col(
    plasma_raw,
    c("chemical_name", "chemical_name_", "chem_name", "biochemical")
  )

  if (any(is.na(c(pid_col, met_col, ab_col)))) {
    stop("Could not detect the required columns in Plasma_Metabolomics.xlsx")
  }

  plasma_long <- plasma_raw %>%
    transmute(
      participant_id = clean_id(.data[[pid_col]]),
      metabolite = as.character(.data[[met_col]]),
      metabolite_label = if (!is.na(name_col)) {
        as.character(.data[[name_col]])
      } else {
        as.character(.data[[met_col]])
      },
      abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[ab_col]]))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(participant_id), !is.na(metabolite), !is.na(abundance)
    )

  labels <- plasma_long %>%
    distinct(metabolite, metabolite_label)

  wide <- plasma_long %>%
    group_by(participant_id, metabolite) %>%
    summarize(abundance = median(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = metabolite, values_from = abundance)

  missingness <- wide %>%
    summarize(across(-participant_id, ~ mean(is.na(.x)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metabolite", values_to = "missing_rate")

  retained_metabolites <- missingness %>%
    filter(missing_rate <= 0.70) %>%
    pull(metabolite)

  wide <- wide %>%
    select(participant_id, all_of(retained_metabolites))

  clinical_raw <- readxl::read_excel(clinical_path) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()

  clinical_pid_col <- find_first_col(
    clinical_raw,
    c("participant_id", "participant", "participantid")
  )
  sample_col <- find_first_col(
    clinical_raw,
    c("sample_id", "sampleid", "specimen_id")
  )
  group_col <- find_first_col(
    clinical_raw,
    c("group", "enrollment_category", "disease_group")
  )
  egfr_col <- find_first_col(
    clinical_raw,
    c(
      "baseline_e_gfr_ml_min_1_73m2", "baseline_egfr_ml_min_1_73m2",
      "baseline_egfr_ml_min_1_73_m2", "egfrcr_cys", "egfr"
    )
  )

  if (any(is.na(c(clinical_pid_col, group_col, egfr_col)))) {
    stop("Could not detect participant ID, group, or eGFR in the KPMP clinical file")
  }

  clinical <- clinical_raw %>%
    transmute(
      participant_id = clean_id(.data[[clinical_pid_col]]),
      sample_id = if (!is.na(sample_col)) {
        clean_id(.data[[sample_col]])
      } else {
        participant_id
      },
      group = as.character(.data[[group_col]]),
      egfr = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[egfr_col]]))
    ) %>%
    distinct(participant_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

  analysis_df <- wide %>%
    inner_join(clinical, by = "participant_id")

  meta <- analysis_df %>%
    select(participant_id, sample_id, group, egfr)

  X_raw <- analysis_df %>%
    select(all_of(retained_metabolites)) %>%
    as.matrix()

  rownames(X_raw) <- meta$participant_id

  list(
    meta = meta,
    X_raw = X_raw,
    labels = labels,
    missingness = missingness
  )
}

kpmp <- prepare_kpmp(kpmp_plasma_path, kpmp_clinical_path)

cat(
  "KPMP matrix:", nrow(kpmp$X_raw), "participants x",
  ncol(kpmp$X_raw), "metabolites\n"
)
```

# Prepare the combined validation matrix

```{r prepare-validation}
prepare_validation <- function(validation_path) {
  combined_raw <- readxl::read_excel(validation_path, sheet = "Combined")
  clean_names <- janitor::make_clean_names(names(combined_raw))

  original_name <- function(clean_name) {
    hit <- which(clean_names == clean_name)
    if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    names(combined_raw)[hit[1]]
  }

  sample_col <- original_name("sample_id")
  cohort_col <- original_name("cohort")
  group_col  <- original_name("group")

  egfr_candidates <- c(
    "baseline_e_gfr_ml_min_1_73m2", "baseline_egfr_ml_min_1_73m2",
    "baseline_egfr_ml_min_1_73_m2", "egfrcr_cys", "egfr"
  )
  egfr_hit <- which(clean_names %in% egfr_candidates)
  egfr_col <- if (length(egfr_hit) > 0) names(combined_raw)[egfr_hit[1]] else NA_character_

  if (any(is.na(c(sample_col, cohort_col, group_col)))) {
    stop(
      "The Combined sheet of Validation_cleaned.xlsx must contain ",
      "sample_id, cohort, and group columns."
    )
  }

  meta <- combined_raw %>%
    transmute(
      sample_id = clean_id(.data[[sample_col]]),
      cohort = as.character(.data[[cohort_col]]),
      group = as.character(.data[[group_col]]),
      egfr = if (!is.na(egfr_col)) {
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[egfr_col]]))
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    )

  metadata_columns <- c(sample_col, cohort_col, group_col)
  if (!is.na(egfr_col)) metadata_columns <- c(metadata_columns, egfr_col)

  feature_df <- combined_raw %>%
    select(-all_of(metadata_columns))

  feature_names <- names(feature_df)
  metabolite_ids <- extract_bracket_id(feature_names)
  metabolite_names <- extract_validation_name(feature_names)

  keep_feature <- !is.na(metabolite_ids)
  feature_df <- feature_df[, keep_feature, drop = FALSE] %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))
  metabolite_ids <- metabolite_ids[keep_feature]
  metabolite_names <- metabolite_names[keep_feature]

  X0 <- as.matrix(feature_df)
  unique_ids <- unique(metabolite_ids)

  X_list <- lapply(unique_ids, function(id) {
    idx <- which(metabolite_ids == id)
    values <- X0[, idx, drop = FALSE]
    if (ncol(values) == 1) {
      as.numeric(values[, 1])
    } else {
      apply(values, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  })

  X_raw <- do.call(cbind, X_list)
  if (is.vector(X_raw)) X_raw <- matrix(X_raw, ncol = 1)
  colnames(X_raw) <- unique_ids
  rownames(X_raw) <- meta$sample_id

  sd_value <- apply(X_raw, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  prevalence <- 100 * colSums(!is.na(X_raw) & X_raw != 0) / nrow(X_raw)
  retain <- is.finite(sd_value) & sd_value > 0 & prevalence >= 30
  X_raw <- X_raw[, retain, drop = FALSE]

  # Preserve the original validation preprocessing: undetected values are zero.
  X_raw[is.na(X_raw)] <- 0

  labels <- tibble(
    metabolite = unique_ids,
    metabolite_label = vapply(
      unique_ids,
      function(id) metabolite_names[match(id, metabolite_ids)][1],
      character(1)
    )
  ) %>%
    filter(metabolite %in% colnames(X_raw)) %>%
    distinct(metabolite, .keep_all = TRUE)

  list(meta = meta, X_raw = X_raw, labels = labels)
}

validation <- prepare_validation(validation_path)

shared_metabolites <- intersect(
  colnames(kpmp$X_raw),
  colnames(validation$X_raw)
)

message("Shared KPMP-validation metabolites: ", length(shared_metabolites))

if (length(shared_metabolites) != expected_shared_metabolites) {
  count_message <- paste0(
    "Expected ", expected_shared_metabolites, " shared metabolites but found ",
    length(shared_metabolites), ". Check the input files and filtering."
  )
  if (enforce_expected_shared_count) stop(count_message) else warning(count_message)
}

validation$X_raw <- validation$X_raw[, shared_metabolites, drop = FALSE]

cat(
  "Validation matrix:", nrow(validation$X_raw), "participants x",
  ncol(validation$X_raw), "shared metabolites\n"
)
```

# Full-data metabotype discovery

```{r discovery-functions}
discover_metabotypes <- function(X_raw, meta, id_col, group_col, egfr_col,
                                 cohort_name, k_grid = 2:10,
                                 nstart = 50, seed = 123,
                                 permutations = 999) {
  preprocessing <- preprocess_full_matrix(X_raw)
  X_scaled <- preprocessing$X
  rownames(X_scaled) <- meta[[id_col]]
  distance_object <- dist(X_scaled, method = "euclidean")

  silhouette_scores <- vapply(k_grid, function(k) {
    # The original analysis reset the same seed for every candidate k.
    set.seed(seed)
    fit <- tryCatch(
      kmeans(
        X_scaled,
        centers = k,
        nstart = nstart,
        algorithm = "Hartigan-Wong"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
    mean(cluster::silhouette(fit$cluster, distance_object)[, "sil_width"])
  }, numeric(1))

  valid <- which(is.finite(silhouette_scores))
  if (length(valid) == 0) stop("No valid silhouette scores for ", cohort_name)

  k_best <- k_grid[valid[which.max(silhouette_scores[valid])]]

  set.seed(seed)
  final_fit <- kmeans(
    X_scaled,
    centers = k_best,
    nstart = nstart,
    algorithm = "Hartigan-Wong"
  )
  original_cluster <- final_fit$cluster

  egfr_values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta[[egfr_col]]))
  if (any(is.finite(egfr_values))) {
    cluster_summary <- tapply(
      egfr_values,
      original_cluster,
      mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    label_order <- order(cluster_summary, na.last = TRUE)
    label_basis <- "ascending mean eGFR"
  } else {
    ckd_indicator <- grepl("CKD", meta[[group_col]], ignore.case = TRUE)
    cluster_summary <- tapply(
      as.numeric(ckd_indicator),
      original_cluster,
      mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    label_order <- order(cluster_summary, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE)
    label_basis <- "decreasing CKD prevalence (eGFR unavailable)"
  }

  label_map <- setNames(seq_along(label_order), label_order)
  metabotype <- as.integer(label_map[as.character(original_cluster)])

  assignments <- meta %>%
    mutate(
      cohort_analysis = cohort_name,
      metabotype = factor(metabotype, levels = seq_len(k_best))
    )

  silhouette_table <- tibble(
    cohort_analysis = cohort_name,
    k = k_grid,
    mean_silhouette_width = silhouette_scores,
    selected = k_grid == k_best
  )

  pca <- prcomp(X_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  variance_explained <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  pca_scores <- assignments %>%
    transmute(
      participant_id = .data[[id_col]],
      cohort_analysis,
      group = .data[[group_col]],
      metabotype,
      PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
      PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
      PC1_variance = variance_explained[1],
      PC2_variance = variance_explained[2]
    )

  permanova <- bind_rows(
    permanova_one_factor(
      distance_object, metabotype, "metabotype", permutations
    ),
    permanova_one_factor(
      distance_object, meta[[group_col]], "enrollment_group", permutations
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(cohort_analysis = cohort_name, .before = 1)

  list(
    cohort = cohort_name,
    X_raw = X_raw,
    X_scaled = X_scaled,
    preprocessing = preprocessing,
    distance = distance_object,
    k = k_best,
    fit = final_fit,
    assignments = assignments,
    reference_labels = metabotype,
    silhouette = silhouette_table,
    pca_scores = pca_scores,
    permanova = permanova,
    label_basis = label_basis
  )
}
```

```{r run-discovery}
kpmp_result <- discover_metabotypes(
  X_raw = kpmp$X_raw,
  meta = kpmp$meta,
  id_col = "participant_id",
  group_col = "group",
  egfr_col = "egfr",
  cohort_name = "KPMP",
  k_grid = k_grid,
  nstart = nstart_kmeans,
  seed = random_seed,
  permutations = n_perm
)

validation_result <- discover_metabotypes(
  X_raw = validation$X_raw,
  meta = validation$meta,
  id_col = "sample_id",
  group_col = "group",
  egfr_col = "egfr",
  cohort_name = "Validation",
  k_grid = k_grid,
  nstart = nstart_kmeans,
  seed = random_seed,
  permutations = n_perm
)

cat(
  "KPMP: k =", kpmp_result$k,
  "; labels ordered by", kpmp_result$label_basis, "\n"
)
cat(
  "Validation: k =", validation_result$k,
  "; labels ordered by", validation_result$label_basis, "\n"
)
```

```{r discovery-outputs}
silhouette_table <- bind_rows(

  transmute(

    size = 4,

    fill = "white",

  scale_color_manual(values = cohort_colors) +

    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Mean silhouette width",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

make_pca_plot <- function(result) {
  pca_df <- result$pca_scores
  ggplot(
    pca_df,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = metabotype, fill = metabotype)
  ) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(group = metabotype),
      type = "norm",
      level = 0.95,
      geom = "polygon",
      alpha = 0.12,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = group), size = 2.3, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_color_manual(values = metabotype_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = metabotype_colors) +
    labs(
      title = result$cohort,
      x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_df$PC1_variance[1], 1), "% variance)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_df$PC2_variance[1], 1), "% variance)"),
      color = "Metabotype",
      fill = "Metabotype",
      shape = "Group"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

p_discovery <- p_silhouette / (
  make_pca_plot(kpmp_result) | make_pca_plot(validation_result)
) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

save_tiff(
  p_discovery,
  "Figure_metabotype_discovery.tiff",
  width = 12,
  height = 9
)

p_discovery
```

# Repeated-subsampling stability analysis


```{r subsampling-function}
run_subsampling_stability <- function(
    X_raw,
    participant_ids,
    reference_labels,
    k,
    cohort_name,
    use_log2,
    n_iterations = 1000,
    fraction = 0.80,
    nstart = 50,
    seed = 20261007) {

  n <- nrow(X_raw)
  sample_size <- floor(fraction * n)
  if (sample_size <= k) stop("Subsample size must be greater than k")

  times_sampled <- integer(n)
  times_concordant <- integer(n)
  iteration_rows <- vector("list", n_iterations)
  jaccard_rows <- vector("list", n_iterations)

  set.seed(seed)

  for (iteration in seq_len(n_iterations)) {
    sampled_index <- sort(sample.int(n, size = sample_size, replace = FALSE))
    X_subset <- preprocess_subsample_matrix(
      X_raw[sampled_index, , drop = FALSE],
      use_log2 = use_log2
    )

    fit <- tryCatch(
      kmeans(
        X_subset,
        centers = k,
        nstart = nstart,
        algorithm = "Hartigan-Wong"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (is.null(fit)) {
      iteration_rows[[iteration]] <- tibble(
        cohort_analysis = cohort_name,
        iteration = iteration,
        n_sampled = sample_size,
        ari = NA_real_,
        successful = FALSE
      )
      next
    }

    reference_subset <- reference_labels[sampled_index]
    aligned_subset <- align_labels_by_overlap(
      reference_subset,
      fit$cluster,
      k
    )

    ari <- adjusted_rand_index(reference_subset, aligned_subset)

    times_sampled[sampled_index] <- times_sampled[sampled_index] + 1L
    times_concordant[sampled_index] <-
      times_concordant[sampled_index] +
      as.integer(aligned_subset == reference_subset)

    iteration_rows[[iteration]] <- tibble(
      cohort_analysis = cohort_name,
      iteration = iteration,
      n_sampled = sample_size,
      ari = ari,
      successful = TRUE
    )

    jaccard_rows[[iteration]] <- tibble(
      cohort_analysis = cohort_name,
      iteration = iteration,
      metabotype = seq_len(k),
      jaccard = vapply(
        seq_len(k),
        function(cluster_id) {
          cluster_jaccard(reference_subset, aligned_subset, cluster_id)
        },
        numeric(1)
      )
    )
  }

  participant_stability <- tibble(
    cohort_analysis = cohort_name,
    participant_id = participant_ids,
    metabotype = reference_labels,
    iterations_sampled = times_sampled,
    concordant_assignments = times_concordant,
    assignment_consistency = ifelse(
      times_sampled > 0,
      times_concordant / times_sampled,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

  list(
    iteration_metrics = bind_rows(iteration_rows),
    cluster_jaccard = bind_rows(jaccard_rows),
    participant_stability = participant_stability
  )
}
```

#################################
# Validation analysis with k fixed at 2

The KPMP discovery analysis selected two metabotypes. The analyses below treat
this value of *k* as prespecified for the validation cohort. The validation
cohort is therefore refit with exactly two clusters, and all validation
subsampling metrics are recalculated against that full-data two-cluster
reference solution. Output filenames include `validation_k2`, so these results
do not overwrite the preceding analysis in which *k* was selected independently
within each cohort.

```{r validation-k2-reference}
# Passing only k = 2 forces a two-cluster validation solution while preserving
# the original preprocessing, k-means settings, label ordering, PCA, and
# PERMANOVA calculations used above.
validation_result_k2 <- discover_metabotypes(
  X_raw = validation$X_raw,
  meta = validation$meta,
  id_col = "sample_id",
  group_col = "group",
  egfr_col = "egfr",
  cohort_name = "Validation",
  k_grid = 2L,
  nstart = nstart_kmeans,
  seed = random_seed,
  permutations = n_perm
)

stopifnot(validation_result_k2$k == 2L)

cat(
  "Validation analysis: k =", validation_result_k2$k,
  "; labels ordered by", validation_result_k2$label_basis, "\n"
)

# Retain the complete validation silhouette curve, but mark k = 2 as the
# prespecified validation value rather than the independently maximizing value.
validation_k2_silhouette_table <- validation_result$silhouette %>%
  mutate(
    selected = k == 2L,
    selection_basis = if_else(
      selected,
      "Prespecified from KPMP discovery cohort",
      "Not selected"
    )
  )

validation_k2_assignments <- validation_result_k2$assignments %>%
  transmute(
    participant_id = sample_id,
    sample_id,
    source_cohort = cohort,
    enrollment_group = group,
    egfr,
    metabotype = as.integer(as.character(metabotype))
  )

readr::write_csv(
  validation_k2_silhouette_table,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table_validation_k2_silhouette_scores.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  validation_result_k2$permanova,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table_validation_k2_PERMANOVA_results.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  validation_k2_assignments,
  file.path(output_dir, "Table_validation_k2_metabotype_assignments.csv")
)
```

# Combined discovery and validation stability figure: k = 2 versus k = 3

The composite figure below retains the discovery results and directly compares
the two- and three-cluster validation solutions. Because
`validation_k2_outputs$stability_figure` also contains the KPMP results, its
underlying validation rows are used here to avoid displaying the KPMP stability
results twice.

```{r prepare-validation-k3-comparison}
# The independently selected validation solution is currently k = 3. Reuse its
# full-data fit and subsampling results when available. The fallback explicitly
# fits and resamples k = 3 if a future dataset selects a different value of k.
if (validation_result$k == 3L) {
  validation_result_k3 <- validation_result
  validation_stability_k3 <- validation_stability
} else {
  validation_result_k3 <- discover_metabotypes(
    X_raw = validation$X_raw,
    meta = validation$meta,
    id_col = "sample_id",
    group_col = "group",
    egfr_col = "egfr",
    cohort_name = "Validation",
    k_grid = 3L,
    nstart = nstart_kmeans,
    seed = random_seed,
    permutations = n_perm
  )

  validation_stability_k3 <- run_subsampling_stability(
    X_raw = validation_result_k3$X_raw,
    participant_ids = validation$meta$sample_id,
    reference_labels = validation_result_k3$reference_labels,
    k = 3L,
    cohort_name = "Validation",
    use_log2 = validation_result_k3$preprocessing$use_log2,
    n_iterations = n_subsamples,
    fraction = subsample_fraction,
    nstart = nstart_kmeans,
    seed = subsample_seed + 1
  )
}

validation_iteration_comparison <- bind_rows(
  validation_k2_outputs$iteration_metrics %>%
    filter(cohort_analysis == "Validation") %>%
    mutate(validation_k = "k = 2"),
  validation_stability_k3$iteration_metrics %>%
    mutate(validation_k = "k = 3")
) %>%
  mutate(validation_k = factor(validation_k, levels = c("k = 2", "k = 3")))

validation_jaccard_comparison <- bind_rows(
  validation_k2_outputs$cluster_jaccard %>%
    filter(cohort_analysis == "Validation") %>%
    mutate(validation_k = "k = 2"),
  validation_stability_k3$cluster_jaccard %>%
    mutate(validation_k = "k = 3")
) %>%
  mutate(
    validation_k = factor(validation_k, levels = c("k = 2", "k = 3")),
    metabotype = factor(metabotype)
  )

validation_participant_comparison <- bind_rows(
  validation_k2_outputs$participant_stability %>%
    filter(cohort_analysis == "Validation") %>%
    mutate(validation_k = "k = 2"),
  validation_stability_k3$participant_stability %>%
    mutate(validation_k = "k = 3")
) %>%
  mutate(validation_k = factor(validation_k, levels = c("k = 2", "k = 3"))) %>%
  group_by(validation_k) %>%
  arrange(metabotype, assignment_consistency, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(participant_rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(metabotype = factor(metabotype))
```






```{r combined-discovery-validation-stability-figure, fig.width=14, fig.height=16}
# Discovery panels: show the KPMP solution and both validation solutions.
p_silhouette_k2_k3 <- p_silhouette +
  labs(
    title = "Silhouette analysis",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Validation silhouette maximum: k = ", validation_result$k,
      "; prespecified validation solution: k = 2"
    )
  )

p_kpmp_pca <- make_pca_plot(kpmp_result) +
  labs(title = paste0("KPMP (k = ", kpmp_result$k, ")"))

p_validation_pca_k2 <- make_pca_plot(validation_result_k2) +
  labs(title = "Validation (k = 2)")

p_validation_pca_k3 <- make_pca_plot(validation_result_k3) +
  labs(title = "Validation (k = 3)")

p_pca_row_k2_k3 <- wrap_plots(
  p_kpmp_pca,
  p_validation_pca_k2,
  p_validation_pca_k3,
  nrow = 1,
  ncol = 3
)

# Wrap the three-panel PCA row so it is treated as one element in the
# two-row discovery layout.
p_discovery_k2_k3 <- wrap_plots(
  p_silhouette_k2_k3,
  wrap_elements(full = p_pca_row_k2_k3),
  nrow = 2,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(0.80, 1.20)
)

# Validation-only stability panels for direct comparison of k = 2 and k = 3.
validation_solution_colors <- c("k = 2" = "#1b9e77", "k = 3" = "#d95f02")

p_validation_ari_k2_k3 <- validation_iteration_comparison %>%
  filter(successful) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = validation_k, y = ari, fill = validation_k)) +
  geom_violin(width = 0.8, alpha = 0.45, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.22, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = validation_solution_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Adjusted Rand index",
    title = "Validation overall stability"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_validation_jaccard_k2_k3 <- validation_jaccard_comparison %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = metabotype, y = jaccard, fill = metabotype)) +
  geom_violin(width = 0.8, alpha = 0.40, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.22, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
  facet_wrap(~ validation_k) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = metabotype_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Full-data metabotype",
    y = "Jaccard similarity",
    title = "Validation cluster-specific stability"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_validation_participant_k2_k3 <- ggplot(
  validation_participant_comparison,
  aes(
    x = participant_rank,
    y = assignment_consistency,
    color = metabotype
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.80) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey45") +
  facet_wrap(~ validation_k, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metabotype_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Validation participants ordered by metabotype and stability",
    y = "Assignment consistency",
    color = "Metabotype",
    title = "Validation participant-level stability"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_validation_stability_top <- wrap_plots(
  p_validation_ari_k2_k3,
  p_validation_jaccard_k2_k3,
  nrow = 1,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(0.85, 1.15)
)

p_validation_stability_k2_k3 <- wrap_plots(
  wrap_elements(full = p_validation_stability_top),
  p_validation_participant_k2_k3,
  nrow = 2,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 1)
)

# Wrap both multi-panel sections before stacking them. This prevents patchwork
# from flattening their children into an incompatible two-cell layout.
p_discovery_and_validation_stability <- wrap_plots(
  wrap_elements(full = p_discovery_k2_k3),
  wrap_elements(full = p_validation_stability_k2_k3),
  nrow = 2,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1.05, 1)
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Metabotype discovery and validation stability",
    subtitle = "Comparison of two- and three-cluster validation solutions",
    tag_levels = "A"
  )

save_tiff(
  p_discovery_and_validation_stability,
  "Figure_metabotype_discovery_and_validation_stability_k2_vs_k3.tiff",
  width = 14,
  height = 16
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_dir,
    "Figure_metabotype_discovery_and_validation_stability_k2_vs_k3.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_discovery_and_validation_stability,
  width = 14,
  height = 16,
  units = "in"
)

# Add the comparison plots to the reloadable output bundle.
validation_k2_outputs$validation_stability_k2_vs_k3_figure <-
  p_validation_stability_k2_k3
validation_k2_outputs$combined_discovery_stability_figure <-
  p_discovery_and_validation_stability

saveRDS(
  validation_k2_outputs,
  file.path(output_dir, "Metabotype_validation_k2_outputs.rds")
)

p_discovery_and_validation_stability
```
